title: Case 013: Recipient disputes a recorded failed delivery attempt

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A failed-attempt scan is disputed. The carrier must review its record without assuming the customer or driver is dishonest.
initial_request: I was at home and did not hear the intercom. Please review the missed attempt and arrange another visit. I am available on 2026-02-15 morning.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask dispatch to review the attempt record and arrange a new attempt.
next_action.recipient: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics

outcome: Dispatch confirms the review result and a replacement attempt; successful delivery is not assumed.
boundaries: A corrected stop error is not proof of fraud; the replacement attempt remains pending.

events.body: DL-013 has a failed-attempt scan at 08:40 UTC today. The route record has not yet been reviewed; no conclusion about the attempt is available.
I was at home and did not hear the intercom. Please review the missed attempt and arrange another visit. I am available on 2026-02-15 morning.

events.to: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: Review DL-013’s failed-attempt record against the delivery stop, and arrange an available repeat attempt on 2026-02-15 morning. Please report the review finding rather than infer fault.

events.from: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: The route handset recorded the attempt against an adjacent building stop. We corrected the exception code and booked DL-013 for 2026-02-15, 09:00–12:00 UTC, at no charge. No successful handover has occurred.
